question: What happens when innate knowledge remains indestructible and pure?
premises: indestructible innate knowledge ends birth-causing ignorance
pure knowledge makes the universe Shiva-like
realization through divine yoga prevents rebirth
inference: indestructible innate knowledge destroys birth and leads to liberation
uncertainties: glosses are approximate for dense compounds
plain_english: When innate knowledge remains indestructible, birth and its suffering are destroyed; through pure knowledge and divine yoga one attains liberation and is not reborn.
